findings.description: The RDS instance sets publicly_accessible = true, giving it a public IP and exposing the MySQL endpoint to the internet, greatly widening attack surface for a backend database.
storage_encrypted = false means the database volumes and snapshots are stored unencrypted, exposing catalog data if the underlying storage or snapshots are accessed.

The master password is supplied via var.password and is stored in plaintext in Terraform state; combined with the static username 'admin' and no Secrets Manager integration, credentials are easily leaked.

The parameter group does not set require_secure_transport (and the app connects with plain mysqli_connect), so client connections to the database may occur unencrypted, allowing credential and data interception.

The database password is interpolated directly into user_data, which is stored unencrypted and retrievable from the instance metadata service (http://169.254.169.254/latest/user-data) by any process or SSRF vector on the host.
No metadata_options block requiring http_tokens = "required", so IMDSv1 remains enabled and an SSRF in the PHP app could steal the instance profile credentials granting s3:*, ec2:* and rds:*.
No root_block_device/ebs encryption configuration is specified, so the instance volume containing the DB credential include file may be stored unencrypted.
The inline role policy grants s3:*, ec2:* and rds:* on Resource "*", violating least privilege; compromise of the web server yields near-full control of storage, compute and databases in the account.
Egress allows all protocols and ports to 0.0.0.0/0 from the database security group, enabling data exfiltration or command-and-control traffic from a compromised database host.
The database endpoint is output without marking sensitive; combined with publicly_accessible = true this advertises the reachable database address.

The DB security group permits 3306 from the entire VPC CIDR rather than only the application security group, so any instance in the VPC can reach the database; with publicly_accessible = true the group is the only remaining control.
